name: okibi-akari-dynamic-highlighting
description: The dynamic layer for the Okibi/Akari design system: the three-phase attention model (Survey 構 · Focus 流 · Edit 異). Band 1 is the color theme; this is bands 2–3.

okibiDynamic.enabled.description: Enable the dynamic focus layer (phases + focused-block indicator).

okibiDynamic.showPhaseInStatusBar.description: Show the current phase (構 Survey · 流 Focus · 異 Edit) in the status bar. Useful for dialling in the dwell timings.

okibiDynamic.debug.description: Log focus/classification/render decisions to the 'Okibi Dynamic Debug' output channel. Requires window reload.

okibiDynamic.dwell.editToFocus.description: Milliseconds of no typing before Edit 異 relaxes back to Focus 流.

okibiDynamic.dwell.focusToSurvey.description: Milliseconds of no caret activity before Focus 流 relaxes to Survey 構 (the focused-block indicator withdraws).

okibiDynamic.dwell.minHold.description: Minimum milliseconds a phase is held before any downgrade, to prevent flicker. Spec starting value: ~350.
